Interface AnswerRepository

@Mapper interface AnswerRepository
Repository for answers. Answer is a weak entity with composite primary key (answer_number, question_id), similar to how chapters use (chapter_id, course_id). We use Long as the CrudRepository ID type (answer_number) but handle lookups and deletes via custom queries that include question_id.
